QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Cleansing the Darkness
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Eremos about the next step in your training.
QuestInfo.1: Horntail's influence has drawn dragons to the deepest part of Minar Forest. Some have even been changed by the power of Star Force... Defeat 500 each of #o8190006# and #o8190007#.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the dragons of Minar Forest and restored nature's balance. But the difference between providence and chaos is still shrouded in mystery. The Ryuul have given this much thought, and it may be wise to learn from them.
